page: Google Cloud Platform c4-standard-48 is a compute-optimized server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8581C processor. It features 48 vCPUs mapped to 24 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, operating at a base clock speed of 2.3 GHz. The architecture is x86_64, supported by a 260 MB L3 cache, 2 MB L2 cache, and 48 KB L1d cache. The instance is configured with 180 GB of RAM, yielding a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 3.75 GB per core. It does not include local storage or bundled GPUs, and has zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark data indicates strong performance across multiple computational domains. The server achieves a Geekbench single-core score of 2175.0 and a multi-core score of 18084.0, placing it in the top 25% tier. It demonstrates top-tier capabilities in image processing and text processing, both ranking in the top 10% of tested systems. Cryptographic and compression tasks are also highly efficient, with a Passmark CPU encryption score of 43744.82 and single-threaded gzip compression throughput of 34.08 GB/sec. For memory-bound workloads, the system delivers a read-only cached small-block bandwidth of 3389.0 GB/sec, though uncached large-block write bandwidth drops to 61.98 GB/sec.

This instance is well-suited for compute-intensive workloads, software compilation, and text or image processing pipelines. It also shows strong capability in low-latency database operations, scoring 21824.99 in Passmark database tests, and static web serving with 74.96 GB/sec throughput. While it lacks dedicated GPU acceleration, its support for Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) and Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX-512) enables efficient CPU-based machine learning tasks, as evidenced by a top-tier text generation speed of 367.28 tokens/sec on small LLM models. However, performance scales down on larger models, with 70B parameter models achieving only 2.81 tokens/sec during text generation. The lack of local NVMe storage requires external disk attachment for persistent data storage.
description: The Google Cloud Platform c4-standard-48 is an x86_64 server instance featuring 48 vCPUs and 180 GB of RAM, powered by an Intel Xeon 8581C processor running at 2.3 GHz. With 24 physical cores and hyper-threading, it provides dedicated CPU allocation and a 260 MB L3 cache. The instance lacks local storage and GPU accelerators. Benchmark results show strong performance, particularly in image and text processing, software compilation, and cryptographic operations. It achieves high memory bandwidth for cached reads and strong static web serving throughput of 74.96 GB/sec. While lacking a dedicated GPU, its support for Intel AMX and AVX-512 instructions enables efficient CPU-based machine learning inference on smaller models. This server is highly suited for compute-intensive applications, software development, database operations, and web serving workloads.
